senses.title: To come near
senses.definition: to move closer to a place, a person, or a point in time
senses.definitionCN: 向某个地点、某个人或某个时间点靠近
senses.example: The train slowed as it approached the station.
senses.exampleCN: 火车进站时慢了下来。
senses.why: Latin appropiare came from ad, 'to', and prope, 'near', so approach is literally 'to come near'.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 appropiare 由 ad「向」与 prope「近」构成，所以 approach 字面就是「变近」。

senses.title: To begin dealing with
senses.definition: to start to handle a problem, a task, or a person in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式开始处理问题、任务或人
senses.example: We need to approach the issue calmly.
senses.exampleCN: 我们需要冷静地处理这个问题。
senses.why: Moving toward a problem is the first step in dealing with it, so the spatial verb became a verb of method.
senses.whyCN: 朝问题走过去就是处理它的第一步，于是这个空间动词变成了表示方法的动词。

senses.title: A way of doing something
senses.definition: a method or line of attack used to deal with something
senses.definitionCN: 处理某事所采用的方法或路线
senses.example: Her approach to teaching is very practical.
senses.exampleCN: 她的教学方法非常务实。
senses.why: The route by which you come at a task is the method you use, which is how the noun came to mean 'way'.
senses.whyCN: 你走向一项任务所取的路线就是所用方法，名词因此有了「方式」的意思。

definition_zh: 合适的；恰当的；占用；拨用
definition_en: suitable for a particular situation, or to take something for one's own use
core_image: 在正式场合换上的一双皮鞋
scene: 葬礼上他换下了运动鞋，穿了一双深色皮鞋。Dark clothes are appropriate for the occasion.
sceneCN: 这里 appropriate 是「合适的」（第 1 个义项：与场合相称）；句意是深色衣服适合这个场合。

senses.title: Suitable for the situation
senses.definition: right or suitable for a particular purpose or occasion
senses.definitionCN: 对特定目的或场合而言是对的、相称的
senses.example: Dark clothes are appropriate for the occasion.
senses.exampleCN: 深色衣服适合这个场合。
senses.why: Latin appropriare meant 'to make one's own', from ad and proprius, 'own'; what is appropriate is what properly belongs to the case.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 appropriare 意为「使成为自己的」，由 ad 与 proprius「自己的」构成；appropriate 就是本属于这个场合的东西。

senses.title: To take for one's own use
senses.definition: to take something, often without permission, and use it as your own
senses.definitionCN: 把某物（常未经许可）拿来当作自己的使用
senses.example: The company appropriated the land without warning.
senses.exampleCN: 公司未经通知就占用了这块地。
senses.why: The verb keeps the literal Latin sense of making a thing one's own, which can shade into seizing it.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了拉丁语「使成为自己的」字面义，这一层含义可以滑向「夺取」。

senses.title: To set aside money for a purpose
senses.definition: to formally assign funds or resources to a particular use
senses.definitionCN: 正式把资金或资源划归特定用途
senses.example: The council appropriated funds for the new library.
senses.exampleCN: 议会为新图书馆拨了款。
senses.why: Assigning money to a use is a legal way of making it belong to that purpose, so the same verb serves budgets.
senses.whyCN: 把钱划归某项用途，就是用法律方式让它属于那个目的，所以同一个动词也用于预算。

intro.en: Appropriate comes from a Latin verb meaning 'to make one's own'.
intro.cn: appropriate 来自拉丁语中意为「使成为自己的」的动词。

items.en: proprius meant 'one's own, particular'.
items.cn: proprius 意为「自己的、专属的」。

items.en: appropriare meant 'to make one's own'.
items.cn: appropriare 意为「使成为自己的」。

items.en: The participle gave the adjective its form.
items.cn: 分词形式构成形容词的形态。

items.en: English appropriate first meant 'belonging to a person'.
items.cn: 英语 appropriate 最初意为「属于某人的」。

items.en: The sense widened to 'fitting the case' and the verb kept the sense of taking over.
items.cn: 词义扩展为「切合情形」，动词则保留「占为己有」之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the own root; the near-meaning group gives other words for fitting.
note.cn: 形近组共享「自己的」词根；近义组是其他表示合适的词。

entries.definition: the act of taking or assigning

normalIntro.en: Appropriate means belonging to this case, this occasion, this purpose.
normalIntro.cn: appropriate 意为属于这个情形、这个场合、这个目的。

normal.en: Appropriate for an occasion, appropriate to a purpose.
normal.cn: 场合用 appropriate for，目的用 appropriate to。

normal.en: As appropriate means choose what fits each case.
normal.cn: as appropriate 意为酌情处理。

normal.en: The verb means take over or assign money.
normal.cn: 动词义为占用或拨款。

normal.en: Misappropriate is the crime of taking wrongly.
normal.cn: misappropriate 指挪用、侵吞。

normal.en: As an adjective stress the second syllable: a-PPRO-pri-ate.
normal.cn: 作形容词时重音在第二个音节：a-PPRO-pri-ate。

abstract.en: See polished shoes set beside gym shoes.
abstract.cn: 想象皮鞋摆在运动鞋旁。

abstract.en: See a key that belongs to one door only.
abstract.cn: 想象只属于一扇门的钥匙。

abstract.en: See a budget line marked for one project.
abstract.cn: 想象预算表上标注某一项目的那一行。

examples.en: Dark clothes are appropriate for the occasion.
examples.cn: 深色衣服适合这个场合。

examples.en: The company appropriated the land without warning.
examples.cn: 公司未经通知就占用了这块地。

examples.en: The council appropriated funds for the new library.
examples.cn: 议会为新图书馆拨了款。

dict_mnemonic.text: ap-（向）加 propri（自己的）加 -ate：属于这个场合的，合适的。

root: 来自拉丁语 appropriare「使成为自己的」，由 ad 与 proprius「自己的」构成；由「专属」发展出「合适」与「占用、拨款」。

sensesIntro.en: Belonging to the case gives fitness, and belonging to oneself gives taking and assigning.
sensesIntro.cn: 属于情形则「合适」，属于自己则「占用」与「拨用」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an item that belongs exactly to this occasion.
core.cn: 核心意象：恰好属于这个场合的一件东西。

intro.en: A Latin word of ownership that works as adjective and verb.
intro.cn: 这是一个表示归属的拉丁词，兼作形容词与动词。

latinIntro.en: The root proprius, 'one's own', also gives property and proper.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 proprius「自己的」也派生出 property 与 proper。

definition_zh: 赞成；认可；批准；同意
definition_en: a favourable opinion of something, or official permission for it
core_image: 文件末尾落下的一个同意签名
scene: 方案在会议上被逐条讨论，最后所有人点头。The plan needs the board's approval.
sceneCN: 这里 approval 是「批准」（第 2 个义项：官方的许可）；句意是这个方案需要董事会的批准。

senses.title: A favourable opinion
senses.definition: the feeling or expression that something is good
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事很好的感觉或表示
senses.example: Her suggestion met with general approval.
senses.exampleCN: 她的建议得到普遍赞同。
senses.why: Latin approbare meant 'to prove good', from ad and probare, 'to test'; approval is the verdict that a thing has passed the test.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 approbare 意为「证明是好的」，由 ad 与 probare「检验」构成；approval 就是「经检验合格」的结论。

senses.title: Official permission
senses.definition: formal agreement that allows something to happen
senses.definitionCN: 允许某事发生的正式同意
senses.example: The plan needs the board's approval.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案需要董事会的批准。
senses.why: A good verdict from an authority becomes permission, because what has been judged good may now proceed.
senses.whyCN: 来自权威的「合格」判定就变成许可，因为被判为好的事现在可以推进了。

intro.en: Approval is the noun of approve, whose Latin root means 'to prove good'.
intro.cn: approval 是 approve 的名词，其拉丁词根意为「证明是好的」。

items.en: probare meant 'to test, prove'.
items.cn: probare 意为「检验、证明」。

items.en: approbare meant 'to prove good, commend'.
items.cn: approbare 意为「证明良好、称赞」。

items.en: Old French aprover gave English approve.
items.cn: 古法语 aprover 给英语带来 approve。

items.en: Approval named the act of judging something good.
items.cn: approval 指判定某事良好的行为。

items.en: The sense of formal permission became standard in administration.
items.cn: 正式许可义在行政语境中成为标准。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the prove root; the near-meaning group gives other words for consent.
note.cn: 形近组共享「证明」词根；近义组是其他表示同意的词。

entries.definition: to think well of or permit

normalIntro.en: Approval is a stamp that says this has been tested and is good.
normalIntro.cn: approval 就是一枚印章，写着「已检验，合格」。

normal.en: Give approval and seek approval are the two common verb phrases.
normal.cn: give approval 与 seek approval 是两个常用动词搭配。

normal.en: Subject to approval means it still needs consent.
normal.cn: subject to approval 意为仍有待批准。

normal.en: The verb is approve of for opinions, approve for permission.
normal.cn: 动词表示看法用 approve of，表示许可用 approve。

normal.en: Disapproval is the negative, made with dis-.
normal.cn: disapproval 是用 dis- 构成的否定形式。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: a-PPROV-al.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：a-PPROV-al。

abstract.en: See a signature at the bottom of a page.
abstract.cn: 想象页面底部的签名。

abstract.en: See a room of people nodding at once.
abstract.cn: 想象满屋的人同时点头。

abstract.en: See a stamp pressed on a document.
abstract.cn: 想象印章压在文件上。

examples.en: Her suggestion met with general approval.
examples.cn: 她的建议得到普遍赞同。

examples.en: The plan needs the board's approval.
examples.cn: 这个方案需要董事会的批准。

examples.en: The budget was passed subject to approval by the council.
examples.cn: 预算获得通过，但仍需议会批准。

dict_mnemonic.text: ap-（向）加 prov（证明）加 -al：证明它是好的，就是赞同。

root: 来自拉丁语 approbare「证明良好」，由 ad 与 probare「检验」构成；由「检验合格」发展出赞同与批准两义。

sensesIntro.en: A judgement of quality turns into a formal permission to proceed.
sensesIntro.cn: 对质量的判定，转化为允许推进的正式许可。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stamp marking a document as tested and good.
core.cn: 核心意象：文件上标明「检验合格」的印章。

intro.en: A -al noun on approve, from a Latin verb of testing.
intro.cn: 这是一个建立在 approve 上的 -al 名词，源于表示检验的拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: The root probare, 'to test', also gives prove, probable, and probation.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 probare「检验」也派生出 prove、probable 与 probation。
